title: 2022 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: The midpoints of the four sides of a rectangle are \((-3, 0),\) \((2, 0),\) \((5, 4),\) and \((0, 4).\) What is the area of the rectangle?

solutions.text:
The four given midpoints form a parallelogram. Its horizontal base has length \(2-(-3)=5\), and its height is \(4\), so its area is \(5\cdot4=20\).

For any rectangle, the parallelogram formed by joining the side midpoints has half the area of the rectangle. Therefore the rectangle’s area is \(2\cdot20=40\).

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: The given midpoints form a parallelogram inside the rectangle
The midpoint parallelogram has half the area of the original rectangle
